title: AURORA View Card
description: A view represents a derived projection or perspective of the model. Views are generated from the card and link structure and do not store independent canonical data.

view_type.description: Type of view (traceability matrix, diagram, hierarchy, dependency graph, etc.)

scope.description: Card IDs or types included in this view

filter.description: Filtering criteria (by status, by owner, by constraint, etc.)

format.description: Output format (mermaid, svg, html, json, csv, etc.)

relationships.description: Relationship types to include (satisfies, implements, derives-from, etc.)
